​As for the food and drink, everything on the table was absolutely delicious. I ordered the Dark Chocolate Hot Chocolate, which was rich, velvety, and not overly sweet—easily one of the best I’ve had. I paired it with a Butter Croissant, which was perfectly flaky and golden. To finish, I tried the Chocolate Cheese Cake Cookie, and it was a total game-changer; the texture was spot on, and the flavors blended beautifully.
​If you’re looking for a spot that prioritizes cleanliness, friendly service, and high-quality treats, Blue Tokai is the place to be. I’ll definitely be returning soon!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Blue Tokai Coffee, Dadar (Kohinoor Mall) – A place for Coffee Lovers & Foodies Alike! ☕🥐

Tucked away on the ground floor of Kohinoor Square Mall in Dadar, Blue Tokai offers a peaceful escape from the city’s chaos — and a fragrant one at that! If you're someone who appreciates a well-brewed cup of coffee or enjoys discovering cozy cafés with a minimalist vibe, this one's definitely worth checking out.

As soon as you step in, you're greeted by warm earthy Indian interiors, soft lighting, and the subtle aroma of freshly ground beans — a sensory welcome that coffee enthusiasts will love. It’s a neat little spot that balances calmness with urban energy, perfect for solo work sessions, casual catch-ups, or even a quiet read.

🔹 What I Ordered:

Cold Coffee – Smooth, well-balanced, and refreshing without being overly sweet. You can taste the depth of their roasted beans. It’s the kind of cold coffee that doesn’t need whipped cream or extras to prove a point – it’s good on its own.

Mushroom Croissant – Flaky, buttery pastry filled with a rich, creamy mushroom mix. The flavors were comforting and gourmet at the same time. It pairs wonderfully with any coffee on the menu and could easily pass off as a light lunch.

🔹 Service & Ambience:
The staff is courteous and well-informed about the coffee profiles (great for curious minds). Service was prompt even during a moderately busy afternoon. The seating is comfortable, with a mix of high stools and cozy chairs. Bonus points for having plug points — ideal for laptop warriors!

🔹 Pro Tips:

Seating is limited, so avoid peak hours if you’re planning to stay long.
Ask the barista for recommendations if you’re unsure – they’re genuinely helpful.
They also sell beans and brewing equipment if you want to bring the café experience home.

🔹 Final Verdict:
Blue Tokai at Dadar is more than just another café — it's a curated experience for those who value good coffee, good food, and good vibes. Whether you're grabbing a quick drink or spending a quiet hour with a book, this spot delivers on both taste and ambiance.

⭐ My Rating: 4/5

featured_reviews.name: Manish
featured_reviews.review_text:
Chaayos has become a popular spot for tea lovers in India, and for good reason. They've taken the classic chai experience and given it a modern twist, with a wide variety of options to choose from. Whether you're a fan of the traditional "cutting chai" or you're feeling adventurous and want to try something new like their "Aam Papad Chai," there's something for everyone.

What I appreciate most about Chaayos is the atmosphere. It's a great place to catch up with friends, have a casual meeting, or just relax with a good book. The décor is usually cozy and inviting, with comfortable seating and a laid-back vibe.
Beyond the chai, Chaayos also offers a decent selection of snacks and light bites. Their "Bun Maska" is a must-try, and they also have other options like samosas, sandwiches, and more. It's the perfect place to grab a quick and satisfying meal or snack to go with your chai.
While the prices might be a bit higher than your average tea stall, the quality of the tea and the overall experience make it worth it. Chaayos is a great place to indulge in your love for chai and enjoy a relaxed atmosphere.

Pros:
* Wide variety of chai options
* Cozy and inviting atmosphere
* Delicious snacks and light bites
* Great for casual gatherings

Cons:
* Prices can be a bit higher than average

Overall:
Chaayos is a must-visit for any chai lover. They've successfully created a modern and enjoyable chai experience that's perfect for any occasion.
Would I recommend it? Yes, definitely!

Overall, my experience at Coffee By Di Bella, Dadar Shivaji Park, was not up to par. featured_reviews.name: Chef Vaidehi Pathare
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been to a few CCD branches, but this was my first time visiting CCD Dadar. It is located near Shivaji Park, and to my surprise, the place was so cool and calm, even when I visited around 6:30 PM. They have both indoor and outdoor seating available. This cafe gave me an old-school vibe, and reminded me of my college days when I used to visit CCD a lot.

I ordered a latte and a Green Apple Mojito, and the order was served within 20 minutes. The mojito was refreshing, and I absolutely loved it. However, I had mentioned while ordering that I wanted it without ice, but it was still served with ice. I informed the staff, but instead of replacing it, they left me to remove the ice myself, which was disappointing. On the other hand, the latte was good and served at the perfect temperature.

I chose to sit outside, as I love outdoor seating, and I had a peaceful experience. The outdoor area is well-ventilated with fans, so it was comfortable. The staff was cooperative, and the washrooms were clean and compact.

This is a great cafe where you can come with friends, family, or even solo. You can sit, read a book, or work in a relaxed and quiet environment. Overall, I really liked the vibe of the cafe, but I feel the service could be improved, especially when it comes to handling customer preferences more carefully.

If you are in Dadar, it's still worth visiting for a cozy cafe experience.

Ratings:

Quality - 4.5/5
Quantity - 4.6/5
Service - 4/5
Price - ₹500 for 2 people

featured_reviews.review_text:
A Fantastic Café Experience at Barista in Shivaji Park, Dadar
I recently had the pleasure of visiting Barista café in Shivaji Park, Dadar, and I must say it was an outstanding experience from start to finish. The café is conveniently located near my home, making it a frequent stop for me.

Upon entering, I was greeted by the friendly and attentive staff, led by the managers Amol and Muskan. Their warm welcome set the tone for the entire visit. Amol and Muskan, in particular, stood out not only for their professionalism but also for their friendly demeanor. Muskan's charm added to the overall positive vibe of the café.

One aspect that immediately caught my attention was the remarkable atmosphere and aura of Barista. Despite being frequently occupied, the café managed to maintain a cozy and inviting ambiance. The well-thought-out interior design, coupled with soft music playing in the background, created a relaxing environment perfect for unwinding or catching up with friends.

The service at Barista was impeccable. The staff consistently went above and beyond to ensure customers felt valued and well taken care of. From promptly taking orders to delivering them with a smile, their attention to detail was commendable. Moreover, even during busy hours, they managed to maintain efficiency without compromising on the quality of service.

As for the café itself, the menu offered a wide variety of beverages and delectable snacks. Whether I was in the mood for a refreshing iced coffee or a rich, aromatic cappuccino, Barista consistently delivered top-notch drinks. The quality of the ingredients and the skillful preparation by the baristas were evident in every sip.

It is worth mentioning that the café could improve in terms of cleanliness, as there were instances where the seating area appeared slightly littered. Nonetheless, this minor issue did not overshadow the overall positive experience.

In conclusion, Barista café in Shivaji Park, Dadar, has undoubtedly won me over as a loyal customer. The exceptional service, inviting atmosphere, and delicious beverages make it an absolute delight to visit. Whether you're looking for a peaceful place to work, catch up with friends, or simply enjoy a quality cup of coffee, Barista is an excellent choice.

Overall, a very disappointing experience in terms of both food quality and service. I wouldn’t recommend this place.

Visited Grandmama’s Cafe recently and had a really nice experience overall. We tried their Peach Ice Tea first, which was decent — not bad, but nothing too special either. I’d rate it around 3/5.

But the real highlight was their Deep Fried Chicken. It was absolutely delicious and easily the best thing we tried there. In fact, we loved it so much that we ended up ordering it again. Definitely a must-try item from their menu.

Overall, the hummus was heavenly, the coffee was excellent, and the pizza was just okay.

We ordered pesto pasta, but they did not serve even a single piece of garlic bread along with it. Usually, any standard café or restaurant provides at least one garlic bread with pasta, so this was disappointing.

We also ordered a brownie shake, but the shake had very little brownie in it. It tasted more like a basic chocolate shake with a lot of cream. Considering the price, the shake did not feel worth it.

Additionally, the restaurant charges a compulsory 7% service charge. However, there was no table service provided — the staff simply placed the food on the table and we had to serve ourselves. We ended up paying around ₹135 as service charge for just two dishes, which feels inappropriate.

Overall, I don’t think the dining experience is worth the price, and I would not recommend this place for dining.

featured_reviews.review_text:
A Modern Coffee Haven Beside Historic Grounds, this Starbucks branch captures that classic blend of convenience, comfort, and quality coffee in bustling Dadar West.

Inside, the space is small yet well-kept, offering cozy seating, good lighting, and occasional views of the leafy park through open walls—a pleasant mix of café buzz and outdoor serenity . It’s popular with both friends hanging out and solo visitors catching up on work or simply enjoying some downtime. Many visitors find it approachable and cozy, with staff delivering courteous service,

On my visit, I ordered a Caramel Macchiato and a Blueberry Muffin, The drink had a standard Starbucks profile—smooth espresso layered with steamed milk and caramel—but felt slightly weaker than expected, lacking richer caramel notes, which aligns with some other customer feedback. The muffin was fresh and pleasantly moist, though not overly sweet—a decent snack to pair with the beverage.

The cafe earns ratings around 4.4 out of 5 on official listings and about 4.5 based on hundreds of reviews—reflecting generally high satisfaction in atmosphere and service, though Zomato lists a more moderate 3.2 dining rating- suggesting some variability in customer experience .

For me, the service was attentive,the staff helpful, and they even engage in ad‑hoc coffee tastings and discussions about the beans—something that felt both informative and welcoming.
In short,this Starbucks outlet is a solid choice for anyone looking to unwind near Shivaji Park—offering good coffee, clean ambience, and friendly service. If you prize boldness in flavor, you might occasionally find the espresso a touch mild—but overall, a comfortable, reliable café experience in Dadar West.

featured_reviews.name: DNB Travel & Food Reviews
featured_reviews.review_text:
Classic South Indian Favourite with Great Food but Limited Parking

Review:
Cafe Mysore is one of Matunga’s iconic South Indian eateries — an institution famed for its authentic idlis, dosas, rasam vada, and filter coffee that have been delighting locals and food lovers for generations. The food is fresh, hearty, and very reasonably priced, making it a go-to breakfast or lunch spot for both regulars and first-timers. The dosa varieties (especially Dilkhush, Mysore masala) and pineapple sheera are often recommended by customers.

The ambience is casual and simple — not fancy, but clean and welcoming. It’s often busy during peak times (especially weekends and mornings), so be prepared for a bit of a crowd and sharing tables, which contributes to its classic local charm.

What We Loved 👍
Authentic South Indian flavours with generous portions.

Quick service most of the time for breakfast and tiffin items.

Pocket-friendly pricing.

Good for family breakfasts and casual meets.

Seating and comfort are basic; the place fills up quickly during rush hours.

Parking & Access 🚗
There is no dedicated parking lot or valet service at the cafe itself.

Being right on Matunga’s King’s Circle area, finding street parking can be challenging, especially during peak morning and evening hours. You may need to park in nearby public parking areas or use paid parking zones near the circle and walk a short distance.

If driving isn’t convenient, the cafe is very well connected by local transport, with King’s Circle railway station just a short walk away.

Best For: Authentic South Indian breakfast/lunch, quick meals, family outings, casual meet-ups.

featured_reviews.name: Vishwesh Ranadive
featured_reviews.review_text:
Cafe Trofima, Shivaji Park, Dadar, Mumbai

Cafe Trofima, located near the bustling Shivaji Park in Dadar, has garnered attention as a popular hangout spot, but it falls short of the hype for several reasons.

Food

The menu boasts a variety of food options, including breakfast platters, which might initially seem impressive. However, the taste of the food is compromised and does not justify the high prices. For a cafe that markets itself as a premium experience, the quality of the dishes leaves much to be desired.

Ambience and Seating

The sitting space is one of the better aspects of Cafe Trofima. Considering it is a cafe, the seating is comfortable and suitable for casual conversations or work. However, the overall ambience is just average, with no music to elevate the vibe. It lacks the warmth or charm that many would expect from a cafe in this area.

Service

The service is satisfactory but nothing extraordinary. While the staff is polite and attends to customers in a timely manner, the overall experience doesn’t stand out as memorable.

Location and Accessibility

A significant downside is the lack of parking space, which can be a hassle, especially given the busy location of Shivaji Park. Visitors arriving in their own vehicles may find it inconvenient.

Pricing

The prices are on the higher side, making it hard to justify for the quality of food and overall experience provided. While there are plenty of food options to choose from, the value for money is not reflected in the offerings.

Verdict

Cafe Trofima is overrated and doesn’t quite live up to its reputation. While it has some redeeming qualities like decent seating and satisfactory service, the compromised food taste, lack of parking, and high prices make it hard to recommend wholeheartedly. It could work as a one-time visit for those curious about its breakfast platters, but better options are available in and around the area for a more satisfying experience.

Overall Rating: 2/5
